Dear Representative Carbajal,

How absolutely spectacular to witness the TWELFTH "60 years" performance! The messaging coordination is so mechanically perfect it's like watching a Democratic politician factory assembly line - each one rolling off with the exact same pre-programmed script and a @HouseDemocrats tag for good measure.

Perhaps between your synchronized recital with AOC, Duckworth, McBath, Schakowsky, Schumer, Krishnamoorthi, Scholten (who posted twice!), Campbell, DelBene, and Heinrich, you missed that the "One Big Beautiful Bill Act" doesn't "gut programs" or "force hospital closures" - it adds BASIC ACCOUNTABILITY while providing $200 million in implementation funding and rural hospital support.

TITLE VII, CHAPTER 1, SUBCHAPTER D, SECTION 71119 establishes community engagement requirements for able-bodied adults without dependents - requiring 80 hours monthly of work, volunteering, or education. SECTION 71120 introduces modest cost-sharing for expansion individuals earning above poverty level. CHAPTER 4, SECTION 71401 creates the Rural Health Transformation Program - literally the opposite of "forcing hospitals to close."

But here's where your @HouseDemocrats "fighting back" campaign gets particularly entertaining: TITLE XI, SUBTITLE A (SECTIONS 110001-110007) extends tax cuts for working families, while SECTIONS 110101-110102 exempt tips and overtime from taxation. Your caucus is literally "fighting back" against tax relief for California workers.

SECTIONS 71112-71118 eliminate duplicate enrollment, prevent payments to prohibited entities, and stop abusive financing practices. Your @HouseDemocrats crusade apparently means preserving $880 billion in fraud, waste, and abuse over 10 years while opposing rural hospital support programs.

Maybe explain to Central Coast voters why @HouseDemocrats are "fighting back" against accountability measures and rural hospital funding while uniformly opposing DOGE's mission to eliminate government waste. What exactly are you all trying to protect from taxpayer oversight?

Also, Salud - this is now the TWELFTH carbon-copy "60 years" script complete with official @HouseDemocrats branding. Did someone just send out the daily talking points memo with instructions to "add official hashtag for maximum coordination visibility"? The messaging synchronization is so embarrassingly obvious it's like watching a political bot farm.

#ReadTheBill #OneBeautifulBillAct #TwelfthScript #Section71119 #Section71401 #HouseDemocratsCoordination #WorkRequirements #DOGEMatters #RuralHospitalSupport #CaliforniaDeservesBetter
